name: acpilot
description: ACP coding assistant powered by ACP backends

acpilot-a.description: ACPilot status bar icon (Agent Client Protocol logomark)

acpilot.experimental.sessionProvider.description: Enable the experimental ACP-compatible VS Code chat session provider surface when the runtime exposes the required proposed API.

acpilot.experimental.acpBackendModelSupp.description: When enabled, ACP backend-specific models (e.g. OpenCode Zen/Go) are registered with sessionOnly=false so they appear in all Copilot session targets. Non-specific models get sessionOnly=true (opencode target only). When disabled, all models get sessionOnly=true.

acpilot.experimental.acpModelBridge.description: [Experimental] Enable ACP Model Bridge — bridges ACP backend models into Copilot's native model picker with full vendor isolation. (Not yet implemented)

acpilot.experimental.checkpointReplay.description: Replay restored session file checkpoints through VS Code chat external edits when available, preserving ordinary workspace edits on conflicts.

enumDescriptions: Disable scheduling and render stream parts as they arrive.
Keep root reasoning, markdown, and root tools continuous; render subagent tools at main-flow boundaries.
Render tools immediately and buffer root reasoning or markdown until their part is complete.
acpilot.experimental.streamSchedulingMod.description: Controls how ACP stream parts are scheduled before rendering to VS Code chat.

enumDescriptions: Spawn a local ACP agent process and communicate over stdio (JSON-RPC).
Connect to a remote ACP agent over WebSocket.
acpilot.backends.acp.mode.description: Connection mode for the standard ACP agent backend.

acpilot.backends.acp.endpoint.description: Remote ACP agent WebSocket URL (e.g. ws://host:4096). Required when mode is 'remote'; the acp participant is hidden while empty.

acpilot.backends.acp.authToken.description: Optional bearer token sent to the remote ACP agent (requires the `ws` npm package).

acpilot.backends.acp.command.description: Command to spawn a local ACP agent (e.g. 'npx'). Required when mode is 'local'.

acpilot.backends.acp.args.description: Arguments passed to the local ACP agent command.
